items.https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/10: Amazon warned that hackers exploited the PHP2Shell vulnerability four days before it was publicly disclosed, and that the flaw—discovered with help from OpenAI and Google AI models after lying undetected for over a decade—is now being broadly exploited worldwide. items.https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/10: Celonis chief scientist Devavrat Shah argues enterprise AI agents need "decision intelligence"—deep understanding of how a business actually operates—to avoid costly mistakes or wasted computing resources. As companies push AI from experimentation into daily operations, giving models the right operational context and guardrails, not just raw capability, is becoming the key challenge.

Executives picturing AI costs usually think of GPUs, but data storage is an overlooked expense: every inference request, unlike one-time training runs, generates data that must be stored continuously. Western Digital found an 8-second AI video clip returned as a 3.97MB file left over 500MB of associated back-end data, showing inference's hidden long-term storage costs.
